facts.text: Task is the DAQmx task object a measurement or generation runs in
A voltage measurement task is a Task with one AI voltage channel: add_ai_voltage_chan('Dev1/ai0') followed by read()
channel_names lists the virtual channels of the task
is_task_done() indicates whether the measurement or generation completed
read() without a sample count returns one sample: a scalar for one channel, a list for N channels
read() with a sample count returns a list for one channel and a list of lists for N channels
read() scales the samples to the units of the measurement; the channel-creation method sets the units
The voltage range is a channel-creation option with the library defaults min_val=-5.0 and max_val=5.0, not a range the clone states for a device
start() transitions the task to the running state to begin the measurement
stop() stops the task and returns it to the state it was in before start()
clear() aborts the task if necessary and releases its resources
close is an alias of clear()

safe_state.description: measurement stopped (Task.stop): the task returns to its pre-start state and no longer acquires
